coverageDefinitions.probed: Initialized in the listed synthetic setup and continued until at least turn 3 or a duel result. This does not assert every effect branch ran.
coverageDefinitions.drawn: Observed in a hand; this includes fixture cards.
coverageDefinitions.played: Observed a native summon or chain activation message for this ID.
coverageDefinitions.activated: Observed a native CHAINING message. Activation can be negated.
coverageDefinitions.resolved: Observed a resolve, ready or automatic effect notice. This is a presentation coverage flag, not proof that every branch resolved successfully.
coverageDefinitions.effectCardNames: Distinct card names from CHAINING messages or automatic/ready/resolve notices, not a count of individual effects or branches.
